source_refs.topic: append-only temporal graph memory / conflict resolution

clayresearch.delta: Fuse adaptive recurrence control, temporally valid memory and schema-aware tool evolution into FRANK staged research while keeping each as separable falsifiable mechanisms.
clayresearch.required_next_test: Rank by information gain after current 16/16 VPS integrity baseline; avoid architecture promotion from paper results alone.

frank.delta: Current H1 baseline is operationally green at the fixed 16-gate VPS matrix. Next candidate is temporal multi-signal recurrence control rather than unconditional deeper recurrence.
frank.required_next_test: Fixed-budget vs single-signal vs temporal-multi-signal controller on matched frozen episodes with cost, false halt, correct-to-wrong drift and recovery.

gwt.delta: Treat ignition/focus as candidate compute-admission/continuation signals, but combine with temporal outcome/stability evidence rather than single confidence or one scalar.
gwt.required_next_test: Ablate ignition/focus contribution to adaptive continue/stop while holding recurrence budget and episodes matched.

emergenz.delta: Overthinking research strengthens the need to distinguish productive recurrence from persistence/drift; efficient stopping is not evidence of emergence.
emergenz.required_next_test: Cross recurrence-regime classification with truthful/shuffled/no re-entry plus lesion/rescue and outcome shadows.

claycode.delta: Loop controller IR should represent temporally aggregated evidence windows, explicit halt/continue reason, cost shadow and falsifiable controller identity without depending on hidden chain-of-thought.
claycode.required_next_test: Compile observable LoopDynamicsReadout/controller semantics through current ClayCode implementation before proposing language changes.

hyperposition.delta: Higher-order alternatives and tool dependencies remain plausible anti-fragmentation mechanisms; recent hypergraph work is supportive motivation, not proof that n-ary structure is necessary.
hyperposition.required_next_test: Higher-order representation vs best pairwise/DAG reduction on cases with true joint dependencies; measure retrieval/planning quality and overhead.

claygraph.delta: Temporal/durative memory and tool-schema relations motivate explicit validity intervals, conflict lineage and possible hyperedges, but graph activation must remain separate from semantic truth/authority.
claygraph.required_next_test: Pairwise graph vs hyperedge representation under temporal conflict and joint tool-precondition workloads, with stale-edge controls.

unifieddb.delta: ACL 2026 temporal-memory evidence supports preserving occurrence/valid time, duration and append-only history while resolving conflict at retrieval; FRANK already has relevant authority/history primitives that should be tested before schema expansion.
unifieddb.required_next_test: Inject changed facts, delayed reports and durative states; compare time-valid retrieval against dialogue-time/point-memory baselines and measure error propagation after replay.

harness.delta: Use the now-green self-hosted Ubuntu matrix as baseline and add the queued adaptive-recurrence differential experiment as a separate research gate, not as release proof.
harness.required_next_test: Execute work_id frank-h1-adaptive-recurrence-20260809 and return a reproducible WORK_EXECUTION_RECEIPT plus negative results.

global_controls: single confidence signal != sufficient stop evidence
higher-order representation must beat best pairwise reduction
